bounded_guard_assessment.choice: One separable dyadic envelope: static minimum nonzero weight LSB exponent plus ceil-log2 of weight L1; dynamic minimum nonzero input LSB plus ceil-log2 of max absolute input. Admit if e_bound-e_min<=23, e_min>=-126 and e_bound<=127; all-zero roots +0, special values fail closed. Nonzero BF16 subnormal inputs are explicitly ineligible, even if their product could become normal; nonfinite values are ineligible before the zero shortcut.
bounded_guard_assessment.proof: All products and any signed subset lie on the e_min lattice with absolute magnitude <=2^e_bound <=(2^24-1)*2^e_min. This sufficient condition contains no runtime product evaluation.
bounded_guard_assessment.metadata: FP8 static exponents fit 4+5=9 bits per original chain: weight minimum -9..6, ceil-L1 exponent -9..12 with spare exceptional/zero codes. Dynamic input extrema computed once per input chain/M row, reused for every output.
bounded_guard_assessment.selection: One host evaluation on the new adjacent capture; require >=80% individual chain-root admission plus zero false positives against exact lattice and scalar roots before proposing a guarded executor. No guard formula/precision scan; native instruction and current complete-unit gates remain independently required.
bounded_guard_assessment.claim: No performance or production selection; static metadata traffic, preparation and fallback must be charged to the whole API.
